primary_endpoint: Changes in serum ALT and liver stiffness by transient elastography from baseline to Week 16; treatment-emergent adverse events leading to discontinuation through Week 20.
efficacy_outcome: ALT changes were -16.3 U/L with placebo, -6.9 with 1000 mg, and -10.1 with 2000 mg (p=0.5946 and 0.7309 vs placebo). Liver stiffness changes were -2.226 kPa, -1.308 (p=0.0763), and -0.727 (p=0.0058), respectively.
safety_signal: Treatment discontinuations due to TEAEs: 1 with placebo and 0 in each epeleuton group. Serious AEs affected 1/31 placebo participants, 0/32 receiving 1000 mg, and 1/33 receiving 2000 mg; no deaths.
